family: VT-05 Circular and elliptical propagation (ML-FR-004 AC1)
description: Geostationary-scale radius, circular, slightly inclined (large scale, long period). Coast of 160 output steps of 5354 s (≈ 10.000 periods), fractional and multi-period times.
status: Committed before any engine run on it (tolerances.md §4.1 item 1). Not yet reviewed or approved; immutable once approved, corrections create a new version (plan §6).

constants.source: WGS 84 values as written in docs/architecture/proposed-architecture.md §3 (ML-TASK-011 dataset input; VT-19 primary-source status in docs/verification/l2-references-report.md)

inputs.requestIdNote: requestId = "sha256:" + hex(SHA-256(UTF-8(canonicalRequestPayload(request)))) per contracts-v1.md §7.1, computed with @mission-lab/contracts canonicalRequestPayload and Node crypto SHA-256 (test code only). The engine-side hash (ML-TASK-017) is not implemented yet; these values can serve its differential test.

model.constantsSource: WGS 84 values as written in docs/architecture/proposed-architecture.md §3 (ML-TASK-011 dataset input; VT-19 primary-source status in docs/verification/l2-references-report.md)
model.units: SI: m, m/s, s, rad, m³/s²
model.time: t_s / Δt: elapsed SI seconds from the epoch (contracts-v1.md §2)

producedBy.independence: Engine source (packages/astrodynamics) not read and engine not run (ADR-003); references import nothing from the engine.
producedBy.numberFormat: Every number is the shortest decimal that round-trips to the binary64 value (ECMA-262 Number::toString); JSON.parse restores the exact binary64. Signs of zero are not preserved (−0 written as 0).

l2a.algorithm: Classical elements from the initial state (L2c raw extraction), E₀ = atan2(√(1 − e²) sin ν₀, e + cos ν₀), M₀ = E₀ − e sin E₀ ∈ [0, 2π), n = √(μ/a³), M = M₀ + nΔt, Kepler equation E − e sin E = M by bracketed Newton, perifocal state from E, rotated by Rz(Ω)Rx(i)Rz(ω). Not universal variables.
l2a.stoppingCriterion: Newton correction |ΔE| ≤ 4u·max(1, |M|), or f(E) = 0, or no binary64 point left inside the bracket [M − e, M + e] (shrunk with the sign of f; steps leaving it replaced by bisection); at most 100 iterations; the iterate with the smallest computed |f| is returned.

l2b.algorithm: Classical fourth-order Runge–Kutta (order p = 4), fixed step, Kahan-compensated state update, on ṙ = v, v̇ = −μr/‖r‖³ in GCRF Cartesian coordinates.
l2b.stepHalving: Runs with h, h/2, h/4; d₁ = ‖y_h − y_{h/2}‖, d₂ = ‖y_{h/2} − y_{h/4}‖ per output time; asymptotic if 2^(p−1) ≤ d₁/d₂ ≤ 2^(p+1), then E_RK = d₂, else E_RK = max(d₁, d₂) (tolerances.md §9.2). Reference value: the h/4 run.

method.firstSample: Index 0 (t_s = 0) is the initial state itself: contracts-v1.md §5.2 revision 3 requires the first sample to be bit-identical to request.initialState (exact; tolerance 0, tolerances.md §1 O-10 adopted).

l2a.bound: P_A(Δt), V_A(Δt) of docs/verification/tolerances.md revision 3 (approved by the owner 2026-11-13) §6.4 (unmargined)
l2a.measuredAgainst: The L2a algorithm evaluated in 200-bit arithmetic from the same binary64 initial state (verification/src/hp/hp-kepler.ts). Measures rounding error only; algorithmic error is cross-checked by L2b.

tolerance.record: docs/verification/tolerances.md revision 3 (approved by the owner 2026-11-13) §7 VT-05, §6.3, §6.4
tolerance.measure: Euclidean norm of the difference at each bit-identical t_s, position and velocity separately

vsL2b.formula: ‖Δr‖ ≤ M·P_E(Δt) + 2E_RK,r(Δt), ‖Δv‖ ≤ M·V_E(Δt) + 2E_RK,v(Δt) (§7 VT-05, E_RK of this dataset)
